name: site-shot
description: Website screenshots for AI agents: real Chromium, full-page capture, ISO-code country proxies, automatic ad & cookie-banner removal. Wraps the published site-shot-mcp stdio server.

interface.shortDescription: Screenshot public web pages, including from another country
interface.longDescription: Renders a public URL in a real Chromium browser on Site-Shot's infrastructure and returns the image: viewport or full-page capture, a country proxy with matching language and time zone, and ad and cookie-banner removal on by default. Requires a paid Site-Shot API plan; captures use that account's existing API allowance and limits.
defaultPrompt: Take a full-page screenshot of example.com.
Show me how this page renders from Germany.
Compare this page at mobile and desktop widths.
